title: Pakistan Fuel Prices (OGRA)
subtitle: Official OGRA-notified retail fuel prices for Pakistan, updated daily

resources.description: One row per product per OGRA notification: effective date, product, price in PKR, unit, and OGRA's own document id.

fields.name: effectiveDate
fields.description: Date the notified price takes effect, ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD), Pakistan Standard Time. OGRA prices take effect at 00:00 PKT.

fields.name: product
fields.description: OGRA's own product name, unabbreviated: Motor Spirit (Petrol), High Speed Diesel (HSD), Superior Kerosene Oil (SKO) or Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG).

fields.name: pricePkr
fields.description: Maximum ex-depot retail price in Pakistani rupees, inclusive of petroleum levy, IFEM and margins. See the unit column: this is per litre for all products except LPG.

fields.name: unit
fields.description: Unit the price is quoted in: litre for petrol, diesel and kerosene; kg for LPG. LPG is notified per kilogram, so treating every row as per-litre misstates it.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Origin of the record. Always `ogra`: every row is parsed from an official OGRA price notification PDF, never estimated or interpolated.

fields.name: downloadId
fields.description: OGRA's own document id for the notification this row came from, so any price can be traced back to the source PDF at ogra.org.pk.
